ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; the visible surface is predominantly low-intensity (dark) with approximately 10-15% coverage of high-intensity (white) pixel clusters scattered throughout.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of small, high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs (approx. 3-10 pixels in diameter) scattered across both lobes on a dark base. High-intensity pixels are more densely concentrated at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 115-degree V-shaped depression at the center; the base of the notch is partially occluded by water-splash pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary; serration amplitude is more pronounced on the lateral halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upward-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial detection of circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters across the entire visible ventral area, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast spotting across the majority of the fluke surface representing historical or current parasitic attachment sites.
